Calculate a weed species' climate suitability across covariate levels

Source: R/calculate-climate-suitability.R
calculate_climate_suitability.Rd

Usage

calculate_climate_suitability(
  gbif_occurrence_data = NULL,
  covariate_summary = NULL,
  covariate = c("kgc", "pb", "phz")
)

Arguments

gbif_occurrence_data

a data frame of occurrence data extracted from GBIF. Augmented with covariate data via add_covariates()

covariate_summary

a data frame summarizing the area, in square miles, of each level of the specified covariate

covariate

a string representing the covariate, either 'kgc', 'pb', or phz'
